sentences.text: Ms. Nupur Dhamija - Deputy Government Advocate for th  respondent/State.

Learned counsel for the appellant submits that as per order dated 01/05/2024, liberty was given to the appellant to file repeat application after completion of 50% of jail sentence if appeal is not reached in final hearing list.

However, a case from motion hearing list to final hearing list normally would travel only on the direction of the Judge or as per per the Registry Policy, therefore it has to be directed to be listed in final hearing list.

The appellant has been convicted for the offence under Section 450 of IPC and sentenced to undergo RI for 10 years fine fine of Rs.1000/- and under Section 376(2)((tha) of IPC and sentenced to undergo RI for 10 years with fine of Rs.4000/- with default stipulations.

On perusal of the record, it is seen that incident is of 20/07/2016 and on the date of judgment i.e. on 04/12/2021 appellant had suffered jail custody from 28/07/2016 to 20/11/2017 i.e. 480 days thereafter the appellant is in jail since 04/12/2021 to till date.

Learned Government Advocate submits that custody report dated 18/10/2025 has been received vide letter dated 2375/warrant/Jail Katni, 2 CRA-983-2022 according to which appellant has undergone the actual custody of 5 years 2 months.
The said application is the seventh application for suspension of sentence.
In view of the aforesaid, list this case for final hearing before the roster Bench in the next week.

(AVANINDRA KUMAR SINGH) JUDGE mc Pankaj @ Sushil vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 1 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/180124263/
